555 W 38 Street, Manhattan, NY 10018
Studios - 2 Bedrooms
$1,400 - $3,600
$49,000 - $238,160
Submit An Application
lyrarerental@housingpartnership.com

New York City is committed to the principle of inclusivity in all of its neighborhoods, including supporting New Yorkers to reside in neighborhoods of their choice, regardless of their neighborhood of origin and regardless of the neighborhood into which they want to move.

Amenities: Recreation room*, Rooftop terrace*, Doorman, Elevator, in unit dishwasher, washers and dryers, Dog washing station, Pet-friendly, High-end kitchen appliances, charging outlets with USB ports, Common area Wifi, Online options for leasing, paying rent, and making maintenance requests, Fitness Center*, Bicycle Storage*, Golf Simulator*, Squash Court*, Sky Lounge*, Game Room*, Resident Lounge*, Coworking Space*, Security cameras, On- site resident manager, Intercommunication device. (*Additional fees apply)
Transit: 7, A/C/E
No fee to apply • No broker’s fee • Smoke-free building • More information, see below or call 646-217-3387
Applications are now being accepted to be placed on the waiting lists. When a vacancy becomes available that matches your income and household size, we will send those households an invitation to submit documents. Qualified applicants will be required to meet additional selection criteria. If you are interested in applying to be placed on the waiting list for this property, please follow the instructions below.
UNITS AND INCOME MAXIMUMS
Please see income chart in the photos and additional notes below.
1 Rent includes gas for heating. Tenants are responsible for electricity.
2 Household size includes everyone who will live with you, including parents and children. Subject to occupancy criteria.
3 Household earnings includes salary, hourly wages, tips, Social Security, child support, and other income. Income guidelines subject to change.
4 Minimum income listed may not apply to applicants with Section 8 or other qualifying rental subsidies. Asset limits also apply.
How Do You Apply?
The steps below must be followed to be considered for an apartment:
1. Request an application from Rockrose via email only at AffordableRental@rockrose.com
2. Complete and submit your application to Housing Partnership via email only at lyrarerental@housingpartnership.com. Applications will be logged in the order they are received.
What Happens After You Submit an Application?
1. If you meet the program requirements, you will receive an invitation to submit documents when a vacancy becomes available.
2. Complete any remaining application requirements as instructed by Housing Partnership to finalize your eligibility.
Please note that we do not accept walk-ins or online applications. You must follow the exact steps above to be placed on the waiting lists. 
DISCLAIMER: Rockrose Development L.L.C. is the exclusive broker/agent for the landlord (“Landlord’s Agent”) for this property. Any broker/agent who contacts management in connection with this listing, who is not the exclusive broker or who does not have a Landlord Broker Agreement, is not the landlord’s broker/agent and will not be paid by landlord. Brokers shall not publish or otherwise advertise any listing without the express written consent of the landlord. This listing is being advertised to prospective renters.
FEE DISCLOSURE: Please be further advised that tenants may incur fees and charges in connection with the rental of Landlord’s properties pursuant to the terms of the lease agreement, including, but not limited to, application fee, amenities fee, parking late fees, pet fees, insufficient funds, window guards, key replacement, and third-party utilities.
